84aI (cstar-no-pu-equalisers-example, vn.tex:6034, Example): the pu-maps f, g : C^4 -> C given by f(a,b,c,d) = (a+b)/2 and g(a,b,c,d) = (c+d)/2 have no equaliser in CStar_pu -- the claim made at the start of thesis A, 20aIII (cstar-no-pu-equalisers, cstar.tex:3073). CStar_pu is not bundled as a category (cf. 47II), so the universal property is spelt out in the statement, exactly as 84bV ha_equalisers spells out the two W* ones: an equaliser would be a C*-algebra E with a pu-map e : E -> C^4 equalising f and g through which every pu-map h : D -> C^4 equalising f and g factors uniquely by a pu-map, and the theorem is that there is no such E, e. The universe is Type, where C^4 and the C^2 the proof uses both live. THE THESIS'S OWN PROOF (vn.tex:6034-6115), step for step. The range of e is the set-theoretic equaliser S and e is injective, both from the universal property applied to C^2 (effectPUMap, the thesis's p with p(1,0) = v, and its 'equalisers are mono'); so e is a linear isomorphism of E onto S = ker(f - g) and E is 3-dimensional; 84II fdcstar then presents E as a sum of matrix blocks with the sum of the squares of the sizes equal to 3, so exactly three blocks are 1x1 and the rest 0x0 -- the thesis's 'E is miu-isomorphic to C^3' -- and the eight vertices of the cube [0,1]_E are the eight projections of E, one for each choice of a subset of the three blocks; a projection is an extreme point of the effects and e carries extreme points of [0,1]_E to extreme points of S cap [0,1], since every effect of S is e of an effect and e is injective and linear; and the octahedron S cap [0,1] has only 0/1 points among its extreme points, of which S contains six. Eight distinct points landing among six is the thesis's contradiction. Two rendering notes, both in the doc comment: extremality is used in its midpoint form (y + z = x + x forces y = x), which on a convex set is the thesis's notion; and the two counts are used only in the directions the contradiction needs, at least eight on the cube side and at most six on the octahedron side, so the eight projections are not shown to exhaust the extreme points of [0,1]_E and no miu-isomorphism E -> C^3 is built, the block sizes from fdcstar being enough to exhibit the eight
